name: iamshobe
description: Agent skills from IamShobe's dotfiles: explainer pages, artifact tooling, code standards, chezmoi and terminal helpers.

plugins.name: explainer-artifact
plugins.description: Visual, TLDR-first explainer page for a change, PR, or refactor.

plugins.name: web-artifacts-builder
plugins.description: React + shadcn/ui artifact toolchain that bundles to one self-contained HTML file.

plugins.name: diagram-design
plugins.description: Editorial architecture, flow, sequence, and state diagrams (by Cathryn Lavery, MIT). Listed here as a dependency of explainer-artifact.

plugins.name: no-smell
plugins.description: Code standards for TypeScript and Python (ts-pattern, strict zod/pydantic parsing, kwargs params, story-first layout), with a PostToolUse hook that flags smells each edit introduces.

plugins.name: chezmoi-helper
plugins.description: Working with chezmoi: templates, encryption, cross-machine setup.

plugins.name: dotfiles-sync
plugins.description: Sync local config edits back into a chezmoi dotfiles repo.

plugins.name: wezterm-config
plugins.description: Edit and validate wezterm.lua: keybindings, fonts, themes.
